author: Praxis VI
title: MPB-GraphFWPCA + DAQB (shared baseline, Auto-λ v2, k=48 cosine)
abstract: Implements MPB-GraphFWPCA with per-PC ridge residualization and density-adaptive quota-balanced graph (DAQB). Uses log1p HVGs, α_g=0.5, PCA50, Auto-λ (target mean γ=0.04), k=48 cosine, kd=20, cap=2.0. Outputs X_emb and graph.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad

# Delegate to shared implementation validated on Human Heart
def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    sys.path.append('storage/shared')
    from algorithms.daqb_mpb_graphfwpca import eliminate_batch_effect_fn as _run
    return _run(adata)
